project_title: Evaluating tide-aware, multi-temporal satellite-derived bathymetry across two Moroccan coasts

survey_collection_window_local.source: User-reported field collection interval; individual sounding timestamps unavailable.

Anza_Agadir.vertical_reference: Hydrographic zero of the Port of Agadir, Morocco
Anza_Agadir.vertical_reference_note: Local site datum. No transformation to the Ras El Ma/Ras Kebdana local zero is defined. The plan-title-block Delta-Z translation is not a hydrographic datum tie.
Anza_Agadir.chart_zero_source: Morocco National Report to EAtHC18 (2024), official hydrographic report; local zero relation to NGM.

Ras_El_Ma_Ras_Kebdana.display_name: Ras El Ma / Ras Kebdana, Mediterranean coast

survey_collection_window_local.source: User-reported field collection interval; individual sounding timestamps unavailable.

Ras_El_Ma_Ras_Kebdana.vertical_reference: Hydrographic zero of the Port of Ras Kebdana
Ras_El_Ma_Ras_Kebdana.vertical_reference_note: Local site datum. No transformation to the Anza/Agadir local zero is defined. The plan-title-block Delta-Z translation is not a hydrographic datum tie.
Ras_El_Ma_Ras_Kebdana.chart_zero_source: Not established in collected sources; do not substitute Port of Nador value.

hls.source: NASA/USGS Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 v2.0

comparison_data.use: Independent contextual comparison only until source lineage and vertical datum compatibility are confirmed. Never use as validation truth when lineage overlaps the survey.

tide_status: Scripts/05_estimate_tides.py fills acquisition anomalies relative to the modeled mean on each local survey date. The user-reported field collection windows are recorded per site; individual sounding times and local gauge validation are unavailable. GOT5.6 anomalies do not assert an absolute tie to either port hydrographic zero.
